diagnosis: The user requests audit entries spanning 12 months – which is within the 400‑day retention window available to our enterprise plan. Exporting can be done via the audit log endpoint, returning data in NDJSON format; the expected job duration is typically under an hour.
reply: I confirmed that our enterprise plan retains audit logs for up to 400 days, so entries from September of last year are still available. To retrieve them, you can initiate an audit log export via the audit endpoint with the desired start and end dates; the export will be delivered in NDJSON format. Export jobs of this size usually complete within an hour, though they are queued by region. Once the job is ready, the file can be downloaded from the provided link. Please let me know if you need any further assistance setting this up.
